== Summary ==
{{Pov|[[Pevara]]}}

[[Pevara]] and [[Androl Genhald|Androl]] speak casually about their mutual distrust and the 'plan' to escape the [[Black Tower]], while Androl continues to work on his saddle. Pevara makes an informed comment about his workmanship, revealing that her uncle was a leatherworker. They are worried that the ongoing storm is a [[bubble of evil]], like one earlier in the week that had caused forty non-channelers to burst into flame. They see ghost in anachronistic clothing wandering through the rain, without getting wet. Pevara and Androl discuss why the [[Red Ajah]] was the only Ajah that had a presence at the Black Tower and Androl says he feels there will no longer be a need for the Reds since ''[[saidin]]'' has now been cleansed. Pevara does not accept that ''saidin'' is clean, since she has seen Androl and his ongoing fear of shadows. Androl expresses frustration that Pevara will not believe that ''saidin'' is clean, so he asks her about [[linking]]. She attempts to show him how to link, and he seizes control of the [[circle]] clumsily. He is overwhelmed at the amount of the [[One Power]] available to him with Pevara's added strength, and begins lifting objects around the cabin at random. He muses about trying to form a [[gateway]] before the experience startles him into releasing the circle. Furious and scared, Pevara [[Bonding|bonds]] Androl to try to gain control over his behavior in the future. Androl is angered that she would bond him without his permission so he responds by bonding her in return. The double bond appears to create a telepathic link, allowing Pevara access to some of Androl's memories and thoughts. Both are stunned by what they have done, but they try to regain some equanimity just as [[Evin Vinchova]] bursts in and says that [[Welyn Kajima]] has been [[Turning|turned]], along with his Aes Sedai [[Jenare]]. They all fear that [[Logain]] has been captured, or will be tomorrow when Welyn says he will return; the battle for the Black Tower may have finally begun in earnest.

{{pov|[[Aviendha]]}}

[[Aviendha]] stealthily approaches [[Elayne]]'s tent, at one point hiding herself in the bushes to avoid the guard's notice. She sneaks into the back of Elayne's tent, then waits for Elayne to finish her council. Everyone is startled when they realize she is there, but Elayne laughs it off. Both women talk about the [[Shadowspawn]] invasion to [[Caemlyn]]. Elayne knows that the [[Ways|Waygate]] in Caemlyn was used in spite of being closed from outside and guarded - Darkfriends in the Queen's Guard opened it and murdered other guardsmen.  She doesn't plan to reconquer Caemlyn, she wants to choose a more suitable battlefield instead. Elayne receives a letter from [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] arguing for her intervention in Caemlyn and relieves her of the commitment to attend tomorrow's meeting, but she believes he is trying to put her back up and make her stay for the meeting tomorrow on the [[Field of Merrilor]]. She admires him for playing the Game of Houses with her, but also finds him frustrating. Aviendha informs Elayne that she has become a Wise One at last, having been to [[Rhuidean]]. She asks Elayne's permission, obliquely, to consummate her relationship with Rand. Elayne grants it, saying this may be the last chance she has before the Last Battle.
